dedupe_keys.name: upto multi city urban objects for building energy simulation

description: The UPTO research team publishes a tiled urban-object dataset for city-scale building energy simulation. Its Figshare page describes 30 US cities with more than eight million buildings, vegetation objects, streets and linked urban tiles and patches. UrbanPatch Topology Ontology represents spatial relationships in RDF. The current metadata identify version 5 and a public ZIP archive, free under CC BY 4.0. Companion code constructs neighbourhood patches, generates microclimates and creates model-energyplus IDF inputs. Coverage consists of source-map snapshots, not a uniform longitudinal survey. A caveat is that urban geometry and topology do not supply all construction, occupancy or HVAC assumptions needed for energy simulation. The own description also contains a malformed street count, which is not repeated here. The deposit and repository documentation were read, but no city files were downloaded or converted.
